-- Schema chưa có bảng điểm/hạng: tính động từ tổng chi tiêu đơn hoàn tất (10.000đ = 1 điểm)
SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name,
       ISNULL(SUM(o.final_amount), 0)                       AS tong_chi_tieu,
       CAST(ISNULL(SUM(o.final_amount), 0) / 10000 AS INT)  AS diem_tich_luy,
       CASE WHEN ISNULL(SUM(o.final_amount), 0) >= 20000000 THEN N'Kim cương'
            WHEN ISNULL(SUM(o.final_amount), 0) >= 10000000 THEN N'Vàng'
            WHEN ISNULL(SUM(o.final_amount), 0) >= 5000000  THEN N'Bạc'
            ELSE N'Đồng' END                                AS hang_thanh_vien
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.user_id AND o.order_status = 'COMPLETED'
GROUP BY u.user_id, u.full_name
ORDER BY tong_chi_tieu DESC;
note: Ngưỡng hạng/điểm là giả định, chỉnh theo nghiệp vụ. Muốn lưu thực tế cần thêm bảng membership.

name: Quản lý Đơn hàng
Quản lý Tồn kho & Nhập kho giày
sql:
-- Tồn kho theo SKU
SELECT w.warehouse_name, rs.shoe_name, c.color_name, sc.size_eu, v.sku,
       s.stock_quantity, s.reserved_quantity, s.stock_quantity - s.reserved_quantity AS co_the_ban
FROM inventory_stocks s
JOIN warehouses w      ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
JOIN shoe_variants v   ON v.variant_id = s.variant_id
JOIN running_shoes rs  ON rs.shoe_id = v.shoe_id
JOIN shoe_colors c     ON c.color_id = v.color_id
JOIN size_charts sc    ON sc.size_id = v.size_id
ORDER BY rs.shoe_name, sc.size_eu;

-- Nhập kho
BEGIN TRAN;
UPDATE inventory_stocks SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + @qty, updated_at = GETDATE()
WHERE warehouse_id = @warehouse_id AND variant_id = @variant_id;
INSERT INTO inventory_transactions (stock_id, [type], quantity, note, created_by)
SELECT stock_id, 'IMPORT', @qty, @note, @staff_id
FROM inventory_stocks WHERE warehouse_id = @warehouse_id AND variant_id = @variant_id;
COMMIT;

-- Cảnh báo sắp hết hàng
SELECT v.sku, SUM(s.stock_quantity - s.reserved_quantity) AS con_lai, a.min_threshold
FROM stock_alerts a
JOIN shoe_variants v   ON v.variant_id = a.variant_id
JOIN inventory_stocks s ON s.variant_id = v.variant_id
WHERE a.is_resolved = 0
GROUP BY v.sku, a.min_threshold
HAVING SUM(s.stock_quantity - s.reserved_quantity) <= a.min_threshold;

name: Bộ lọc & Tìm kiếm nâng cao (Lọc theo hãng, size, màu, giá)
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name,
       rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) AS gia_hien_tai
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (@brand_id IS NULL OR rs.brand_id = @brand_id)
  AND (@size_id  IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.size_id  = @size_id  AND v.is_active = 1))
  AND (@color_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.color_id = @color_id AND v.is_active = 1))
  AND COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) BETWEEN ISNULL(@min_price, 0) AND ISNULL(@max_price, 999999999)
  AND (@keyword IS NULL OR rs.shoe_name LIKE N'%' + @keyword + N'%')
ORDER BY gia_hien_tai;

-- Tạo giao dịch thanh toán khi đặt hàng
INSERT INTO payments (order_id, payment_method, payment_status)
VALUES (@order_id, @payment_method, 'PENDING');  -- 'VNPAY' | 'MOMO' | 'ZALOPAY'

-- Callback từ cổng thanh toán: thành công
UPDATE payments
SET payment_status = 'PAID', transaction_code = @transaction_code, paid_at = GETDATE()
WHERE order_id = @order_id AND payment_status = 'PENDING';

IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    UPDATE orders SET order_status = 'CONFIRMED' WHERE order_id = @order_id AND order_status = 'PENDING';

-- Callback: thất bại
UPDATE payments SET payment_status = 'FAILED', transaction_code = @transaction_code
WHERE order_id = @order_id AND payment_status = 'PENDING';

name: Thanh toán & Đối soát giao dịch
sql:
SELECT p.payment_id, o.order_code, p.payment_method, p.transaction_code, p.payment_status, p.paid_at, o.final_amount
FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE (@method IS NULL OR p.payment_method = @method)
  AND (@from_date IS NULL OR p.paid_at >= @from_date)
  AND (@to_date   IS NULL OR p.paid_at <  DATEADD(DAY, 1, @to_date))
ORDER BY p.paid_at DESC;

-- Đối soát: đơn đã thanh toán nhưng chưa có mã giao dịch / số tiền không khớp
SELECT o.order_code, p.payment_method, p.transaction_code, o.final_amount
FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.payment_status = 'PAID' AND (p.transaction_code IS NULL OR p.paid_at IS NULL);

-- Tổng tiền theo cổng
SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS so_gd, SUM(o.final_amount) AS tong_tien
FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.payment_status = 'PAID' GROUP BY payment_method;

name: Thống kê & Báo cáo doanh thu

-- Doanh thu theo ngày (từ bảng thống kê)
SELECT stat_date, SUM(total_shoes_sold) AS so_doi, SUM(total_revenue) AS doanh_thu
FROM daily_sales_analytics
WHERE stat_date BETWEEN @from_date AND @to_date
GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date;

-- Doanh thu theo thương hiệu
SELECT b.brand_name, SUM(d.total_shoes_sold) AS so_doi, SUM(d.total_revenue) AS doanh_thu
FROM daily_sales_analytics d JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = d.brand_id
WHERE d.stat_date BETWEEN @from_date AND @to_date
GROUP BY b.brand_name ORDER BY doanh_thu DESC;

-- Doanh thu theo tháng (tính trực tiếp từ đơn hàng)
SELECT FORMAT(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') AS thang, COUNT(*) AS so_don, SUM(final_amount) AS doanh_thu
FROM orders
WHERE order_status IN ('DELIVERED', 'COMPLETED')
GROUP BY FORMAT(created_at, 'yyyy-MM') ORDER BY thang;

name: Hệ thống Gợi ý sản phẩm thông minh
sql:
-- Lưu phiên tư vấn
INSERT INTO recommendation_sessions (user_id, profile_id, input_weight_kg, selected_distance_id,
    selected_terrain_id, selected_arch_id, selected_budget_id)
VALUES (@user_id, @profile_id, @weight_kg, @distance_id, @terrain_id, @arch_id, @budget_id);
DECLARE @session_id INT = SCOPE_IDENTITY();

-- Chấm điểm theo trọng số recommendation_rules
SELECT TOP 10 rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_name, rs.base_price,
  CAST(r.weight_weight_percent    * CASE WHEN rs.suitable_weight_group_id = wg.weight_group_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + r.distance_weight_percent  * CASE WHEN rs.suitable_distance_id = @distance_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + r.terrain_weight_percent   * CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_suitable_terrains st
                                        WHERE st.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND st.terrain_id = @terrain_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + r.foot_arch_weight_percent * CASE WHEN rs.suitable_arch_id = @arch_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + r.budget_weight_percent    * CASE WHEN COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) BETWEEN br.min_price AND br.max_price THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS match_score
FROM running_shoes rs
CROSS JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 * FROM recommendation_rules WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY rule_id DESC) r
CROSS JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 weight_group_id FROM weight_groups WHERE @weight_kg BETWEEN min_weight_kg AND max_weight_kg) wg
CROSS JOIN (SELECT min_price, max_price FROM budget_ranges WHERE budget_id = @budget_id) br
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rs.is_beginner_friendly = 1
ORDER BY match_score DESC;

-- Lưu kết quả
INSERT INTO recommendation_results (session_id, shoe_id, match_score, rank_position, match_reason_arch)
VALUES (@session_id, @shoe_id, @match_score, @rank_position, @reason_arch);

FROM users u
WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.phone_number IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.user_id = u.user_id AND o.order_status = 'SHIPPING');

-- OTP SMS dùng user_verifications
INSERT INTO user_verifications (user_id, [type], code, expires_at)
VALUES (@user_id, 'PHONE', @otp_code, DATEADD(MINUTE, 5, GETDATE()));
note: Chưa có bảng notifications/device_tokens; nên thêm nếu cần push.

name: Quản lý Bộ sưu tập & Chiến dịch Mùa vụ
sql:
-- Schema chưa có bảng bộ sưu tập. Tạm dùng product_series làm bộ sưu tập, banner làm chiến dịch
SELECT ps.series_id, ps.series_name, b.brand_name, COUNT(rs.shoe_id) AS so_mau_giay
FROM product_series ps
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = ps.brand_id
LEFT JOIN running_shoes rs ON rs.series_id = ps.series_id AND rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ps.series_id, ps.series_name, b.brand_name;

SELECT banner_id, title, target_url FROM cms_banners WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY display_order;
note: Chưa có bảng collections/campaigns.

name: Lọc giày chạy bộ đường nhựa (Road Running)
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, st.suitability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_suitable_terrains st ON st.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN terrain_types t ON t.terrain_id = st.terrain_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND st.suitability_score >= 3 AND t.terrain_code = 'ROAD'
ORDER BY st.suitability_score DESC, rs.base_price;

name: Lọc giày chạy bộ địa hình (Trail Running)
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, st.suitability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_suitable_terrains st ON st.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN terrain_types t ON t.terrain_id = st.terrain_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND st.suitability_score >= 3 AND t.terrain_code = 'TRAIL'
ORDER BY st.suitability_score DESC, rs.base_price;

name: Lọc giày chạy bộ trên máy (Treadmill Running)
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, st.suitability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_suitable_terrains st ON st.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN terrain_types t ON t.terrain_id = st.terrain_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND st.suitability_score >= 3 AND t.terrain_code = 'TREADMILL'
ORDER BY st.suitability_score DESC, rs.base_price;

name: Lọc giày chạy bộ đa địa hình
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, st.suitability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_suitable_terrains st ON st.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN terrain_types t ON t.terrain_id = st.terrain_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND st.suitability_score >= 3 AND t.terrain_code = 'MIXED'
ORDER BY st.suitability_score DESC, rs.base_price;

name: Lọc giày theo độ bám mặt đường
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, t.terrain_name, t.grip_requirement, st.suitability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_suitable_terrains st ON st.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN terrain_types t ON t.terrain_id = st.terrain_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND t.terrain_code = @terrain_code
  AND st.suitability_score >= @min_score
ORDER BY st.suitability_score DESC;
note: Độ bám lấy từ yêu cầu bám của địa hình + điểm phù hợp (suitability_score).

name: Lọc giày theo cấu trúc đế ngoài
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, tt.tech_name AS cau_truc_de_ngoai, rs.outsole_durability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_tech_mappings m ON m.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN shoe_technologies tt ON tt.tech_id = m.tech_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND tt.tech_type = 'OUTSOLE'
ORDER BY rs.outsole_durability_score DESC;

name: Lọc giày theo khả năng chống trượt
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, AVG(CAST(r.grip_rating AS DECIMAL(3,2))) AS diem_bam_tb
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_reviews r ON r.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND r.status = 'APPROVED' AND r.grip_rating IS NOT NULL
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
HAVING AVG(CAST(r.grip_rating AS DECIMAL(3,2))) >= @min_grip
ORDER BY diem_bam_tb DESC;
note: Dùng điểm grip_rating trung bình từ đánh giá đã duyệt.

name: Lọc giày theo khả năng chống mài mòn
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.outsole_durability_score
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.outsole_durability_score >= @min_durability
ORDER BY rs.outsole_durability_score DESC;

name: Lọc giày theo khả năng bảo vệ bàn chân
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.midsole_thickness_mm, rs.cushion_level, rs.stability_level
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.midsole_thickness_mm >= @min_midsole_mm
  AND rs.stability_level IN (N'Stability', N'Motion Control')
ORDER BY rs.midsole_thickness_mm DESC;
note: Bảo vệ bàn chân quy đổi từ độ dày đế giữa + mức ổn định.

name: Lọc giày theo khả năng chống nước
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.waterproof_capability = 1;

name: Lọc giày theo độ linh hoạt của đế
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.midsole_thickness_mm, rs.weight_gram, rs.cushion_level
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.cushion_level = @cushion_level
ORDER BY rs.midsole_thickness_mm ASC, rs.weight_gram ASC;
note: Schema chưa có cột độ linh hoạt; dùng đế mỏng/nhẹ + cushion_level (Soft/Medium/Firm) để suy ra.

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân bình thường (Normal Arch)
sql:
-- Thông tin kiểu bàn chân + giày phù hợp
SELECT a.arch_code, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed
FROM foot_arch_types a WHERE a.arch_code = 'NORMAL_ARCH';

SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_code = 'NORMAL_ARCH'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân vòm thấp (Low Arch)
sql:
-- Thông tin kiểu bàn chân + giày phù hợp
SELECT a.arch_code, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed
FROM foot_arch_types a WHERE a.arch_code = 'LOW_ARCH';

SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_code = 'LOW_ARCH'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân vòm cao (High Arch)
sql:
-- Thông tin kiểu bàn chân + giày phù hợp
SELECT a.arch_code, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed
FROM foot_arch_types a WHERE a.arch_code = 'HIGH_ARCH';

SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_code = 'HIGH_ARCH'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân bẹt (Flat Feet)
sql:
-- Thông tin kiểu bàn chân + giày phù hợp
SELECT a.arch_code, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed
FROM foot_arch_types a WHERE a.arch_code = 'FLAT_FEET';

SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_code = 'FLAT_FEET'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân rộng (Wide Feet)
sql:
-- Thông tin kiểu bàn chân + giày phù hợp
SELECT a.arch_code, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed
FROM foot_arch_types a WHERE a.arch_code = 'WIDE_FEET';

SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_code = 'WIDE_FEET'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

-- Hoặc theo biến thể bản rộng
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.width_option IN (N'Wide', N'Extra Wide'));

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân hẹp (Narrow Feet)
sql:
-- Thông tin kiểu bàn chân + giày phù hợp
SELECT a.arch_code, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed
FROM foot_arch_types a WHERE a.arch_code = 'NARROW_FEET';

SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_code = 'NARROW_FEET'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

-- Hoặc theo biến thể bản hẹp
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.width_option = N'Narrow');

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân có độ bè lớn ở mũi
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price,
       (SELECT AVG(CAST(forefoot_width_rating AS DECIMAL(3,2))) FROM shoe_reviews WHERE shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND status = 'APPROVED') AS diem_rong_mui
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.width_option IN (N'Wide', N'Extra Wide'));

-- Lưu số đo của khách
UPDATE runner_foot_measurements SET forefoot_width_type = N'Wide', measured_at = GETDATE() WHERE profile_id = @profile_id;

name: Chọn kiểu bàn chân có gót chân hẹp
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.width_option = N'Narrow');

-- Lưu số đo của khách
UPDATE runner_foot_measurements SET heel_width_type = N'Narrow', measured_at = GETDATE() WHERE profile_id = @profile_id;

name: Xem hướng dẫn xác định kiểu bàn chân
Xem hướng dẫn kiểm tra độ cao vòm chân
note: Dùng chung guide_type với mục trên (guide_type UNIQUE). Nếu cần tách, thêm guide mới như HOW_TO_CHECK_ARCH_HEIGHT.

name: Xem hướng dẫn đo chiều dài bàn chân
note: Dùng chung HOW_TO_MEASURE_FOOT với đo chiều rộng.

name: Xem hướng dẫn đo chiều rộng bàn chân
note: Dùng chung HOW_TO_MEASURE_FOOT với đo chiều dài.

name: Lọc giày theo kiểu bàn chân
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.arch_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.suitable_arch_id = @arch_type_id
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Lọc giày theo độ rộng mũi giày
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_variants v ON v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.is_active = 1
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND v.width_option = @width_option;
-- @width_option: Narrow | Standard | Wide | Extra Wide
note: Độ rộng lấy từ shoe_variants.width_option.

name: Lọc giày theo độ rộng thân giày
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_variants v ON v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.is_active = 1
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND v.width_option = @width_option;
note: Schema chỉ có width_option chung cho cả giày (không tách mũi/thân).

name: Lọc giày theo cấu trúc hỗ trợ vòm chân
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, a.support_feature_needed
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = rs.suitable_arch_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND a.arch_type_id = @arch_type_id
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Lọc giày theo khả năng ổn định bàn chân
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.stability_level
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.stability_level = @stability_level
ORDER BY rs.base_price;
-- @stability_level: Neutral | Stability | Motion Control

name: Lọc giày theo cấu trúc hỗ trợ gót chân
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, tt.tech_name AS cong_nghe_ho_tro_got
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_tech_mappings m ON m.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN shoe_technologies tt ON tt.tech_id = m.tech_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND tt.tech_type = 'STABILITY'
ORDER BY rs.base_price;

name: Gợi ý giày theo kiểu bàn chân
sql:
SELECT TOP 10 rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, a.arch_name
FROM runner_foot_measurements m
JOIN foot_arch_types a  ON a.arch_code = REPLACE(UPPER(m.arch_type), ' ', '_')
JOIN running_shoes rs   ON rs.suitable_arch_id = a.arch_type_id
JOIN brands b           ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE m.profile_id = @profile_id AND rs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rs.is_beginner_friendly = 1
ORDER BY rs.energy_return_percent DESC, rs.base_price;
note: Join qua REPLACE(UPPER(arch_type)) vì arch_type là text tự do (vd 'Flat Feet' -> FLAT_FEET).

name: Xem lý do giày phù hợp với kiểu bàn chân
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_name, a.arch_name, a.support_feature_needed, rr.match_reason_arch, rr.match_score
FROM recommendation_results rr
JOIN running_shoes rs  ON rs.shoe_id = rr.shoe_id
JOIN recommendation_sessions s ON s.session_id = rr.session_id
JOIN foot_arch_types a ON a.arch_type_id = s.selected_arch_id
WHERE rr.session_id = @session_id AND rr.shoe_id = @shoe_id;

name: Lọc giày theo khoảng giá
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) AS gia_hien_tai
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) BETWEEN @min_price AND @max_price
ORDER BY gia_hien_tai;

name: Lọc giày theo giá thấp nhất
sql:
SELECT TOP (@top) rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) AS gia_hien_tai
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY gia_hien_tai ASC;

name: Lọc giày theo giá cao nhất
sql:
SELECT TOP (@top) rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) AS gia_hien_tai
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY gia_hien_tai DESC;

name: Lọc giày đang giảm giá
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.base_price - rs.sale_price AS so_tien_giam
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.sale_price IS NOT NULL AND rs.sale_price < rs.base_price
ORDER BY so_tien_giam DESC;

name: Lọc giày theo tỷ lệ giảm giá
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, CAST((rs.base_price - rs.sale_price) * 100.0 / rs.base_price AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS ty_le_giam
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.sale_price IS NOT NULL AND (rs.base_price - rs.sale_price) * 100.0 / rs.base_price >= @min_discount_percent
ORDER BY ty_le_giam DESC;

name: Gợi ý giày theo ngân sách
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, br.range_label
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
CROSS JOIN budget_ranges br
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND br.budget_id = @budget_id
  AND COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) BETWEEN br.min_price AND br.max_price
ORDER BY rs.is_beginner_friendly DESC, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) DESC;

name: Gợi ý giày có hiệu năng tốt trong ngân sách
sql:
SELECT TOP 10 rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.energy_return_percent, rs.cushion_level, rs.weight_gram
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
CROSS JOIN budget_ranges br
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND br.budget_id = @budget_id
  AND COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) BETWEEN br.min_price AND br.max_price
  AND rs.energy_return_percent IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY rs.energy_return_percent DESC, rs.weight_gram ASC;

name: Sắp xếp giày theo giá tăng dần
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) AS gia_hien_tai
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY gia_hien_tai ASC;

name: Sắp xếp giày theo giá giảm dần
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, COALESCE(rs.sale_price, rs.base_price) AS gia_hien_tai
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY gia_hien_tai DESC;

name: Tìm kiếm giày theo tên sản phẩm
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.shoe_name LIKE N'%' + @keyword + N'%';

name: Tìm kiếm giày theo thương hiệu
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND b.brand_name LIKE N'%' + @keyword + N'%';

name: Tìm kiếm giày theo mã sản phẩm
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.shoe_code LIKE '%' + @keyword + '%';

name: Tìm kiếm giày theo dòng sản phẩm
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, ps.series_name
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN product_series ps ON ps.series_id = rs.series_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND ps.series_name LIKE N'%' + @keyword + N'%';

name: Tìm kiếm giày theo mục đích sử dụng
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, d.distance_label, d.purpose_type
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN running_distances d ON d.distance_id = rs.suitable_distance_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND (d.purpose_type LIKE N'%' + @keyword + N'%' OR d.distance_label LIKE N'%' + @keyword + N'%');

name: Lọc giày theo thương hiệu
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.brand_id = @brand_id;

name: Lọc giày theo giới tính
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.gender_target
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.gender_target IN (@gender, N'Unisex');
note: @gender: Nam | Nữ | Unisex

name: Lọc giày theo kích thước
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_variants v ON v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.is_active = 1
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND v.size_id = @size_id;

name: Lọc giày theo màu sắc
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_variants v ON v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.is_active = 1
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND v.color_id = @color_id;

name: Lọc giày theo loại đế
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, tt.tech_name, tt.tech_type
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_tech_mappings m ON m.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN shoe_technologies tt ON tt.tech_id = m.tech_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND tt.tech_type IN ('OUTSOLE', 'MIDSOLE') AND tt.tech_id = @tech_id;

name: Lọc giày theo công nghệ đệm
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, tt.tech_name, rs.cushion_level
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN shoe_tech_mappings m ON m.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id
JOIN shoe_technologies tt ON tt.tech_id = m.tech_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND tt.tech_type = 'MIDSOLE' AND tt.tech_id = @tech_id;

name: Lọc giày theo trọng lượng giày
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.weight_gram
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.weight_gram BETWEEN @min_gram AND @max_gram
ORDER BY rs.weight_gram;

name: Lọc giày theo độ dày đế
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.midsole_thickness_mm
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.midsole_thickness_mm BETWEEN @min_mm AND @max_mm
ORDER BY rs.midsole_thickness_mm;

name: Lọc giày theo độ chênh lệch gót và mũi (Drop)
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.heel_to_toe_drop_mm
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.heel_to_toe_drop_mm BETWEEN @min_drop AND @max_drop
ORDER BY rs.heel_to_toe_drop_mm;

name: Lọc giày theo chất liệu thân giày
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, rs.upper_material
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.upper_material LIKE N'%' + @material + N'%';

name: Lọc giày theo mục đích tập luyện
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, d.distance_label, d.purpose_type
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
JOIN running_distances d ON d.distance_id = rs.suitable_distance_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND rs.suitable_distance_id = @distance_id;

name: Lọc giày theo tình trạng còn hàng
sql:
SELECT rs.shoe_id, rs.shoe_code, rs.shoe_name, b.brand_name, rs.base_price, rs.sale_price, (SELECT SUM(s.stock_quantity - s.reserved_quantity) FROM shoe_variants v JOIN inventory_stocks s ON s.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id) AS ton_kha_dung
FROM running_shoes rs
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = rs.brand_id
WHERE rs.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shoe_variants v JOIN inventory_stocks s ON s.variant_id = v.variant_id
              WHERE v.shoe_id = rs.shoe_id AND v.is_active = 1 AND s.stock_quantity - s.reserved_quantity > 0);
